title: Noble Signs restores NYC’s storefront signage so you “feel at home before you’ve stepped in your own door”

paragraphs.text: David Barnett, co-founder of Noble Signs, joined us on the Nicer Tuesdays stage in New York City to talk about what he loves most: signage, especially in the Big Apple. The graphic designer talked about collecting over 200 storefront signs in New York City and how the studio draws everything by hand, is shaped by reviving vanishing signage and how the team restores loved and lost signs to clients such as bakeries and delis.
paragraphs.translation: Noble Signs 的共同創辦人 David Barnett 加入了我們在紐約市舉辦的 Nicer Tuesdays 講座，分享他最熱愛的事物：招牌，特別是位於大蘋果（紐約）的招牌。這位平面設計師談到了他在紐約市收集了超過 200 個店面招牌的故事，以及他的工作室如何堅持全手工繪製、如何受到復興消逝中招牌的影響，以及團隊如何為麵包店和熟食店等客戶修復那些備受喜愛但已損毀的招牌。

paragraphs.text: Come and join us at Nicer Tuesdays
paragraphs.translation: 來加入我們的 Nicer Tuesdays

paragraphs.text: If inspiring talks from original creatives sounds like your kinda thing, sign up to our Nicer Tuesdays newsletter for first dibs on tickets.

paragraphs.text: We’re excited to partner with Love Corn the UK’s first crunchy corn brand as our snack sponsor. Its delicious crunchy corn kernels are packed with flavour and made with love. On trend with being low sugar, gluten-free and vegan, it’s the feel good snack so please enjoy!
paragraphs.translation: 我們很高興能與英國首個脆玉米品牌 Love Corn 合作，擔任我們的點心贊助商。其美味的脆玉米粒充滿風味且用心製作。符合低糖、無麩質和純素的趨勢，這是一款讓人心情愉悅的零食，請盡情享用！

paragraphs.text: Nicer Tuesdays is our monthly event of creative talks. You can find out more here.
paragraphs.translation: Nicer Tuesdays 是我們每月舉辦一次的創意講座活動。你可以在這裡了解更多資訊。
